REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
THURSDAY - SEPTEMBER 4, 2025 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Recreation Services Division, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Recreation Services Division during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to recreation@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1254 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 5.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to recreation@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Recreation Services Division no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Recreation Services Division at (562) 916-1254 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

minutes_text:
CITY OF CERRITOS
  MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  SEPTEMBER4, 2025

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  Commissioner DeLeon led in the Pledge of Allegiance.

3.  Roll Call

  PRESENT:  Commissioner Alex Camargo
  Commissioner Cathy DeLeon
  CommissionerJose Iglesias
  Vice Chair Pat Patnaik (arrived at 7:03 p.m.)
  Chair Ileana Prado

  All Members of the Parks and Recreation Commission were declared present, except
  Vice Chair Patnaik.

4.  Presentations

4A.  Presentations

  Vice Chair Patnaik arrived at this juncture.

  Acting Recreation Services Superintendent Samir Patel recognized Recreation Leader II
  Adam Garcia as Employee of the Month for July.
5.  Public Comments and Suggestions
  David Pylman mentioned a prior meeting of the Commission where a member of the
  public was allowed to comment at the end of the meeting and felt the City should not
  set that as a precedent; spoke about needingto revisit the City’s facility reservation
  process and addressed upcoming changes in Commission/Committee rules.

  Mr. Patel reported receiving one piece of written correspondence from Murali
  Vasudevan,Cerritos, about public feeding of wildlife at Heritage Park.

  Brief discussion followed regarding the possibility of increasing maintenance,
  increasingthe size of signage, and addressingenforcementthrough the California
  Code versus City ordinance.

6.  Consent Calendar

6A  Approval of Minutes – Thursday, August 7, 2025, 5:00 p.m. Parks and Recreation
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes
   MOTION: Vice Chair Patnaik moved to approve the Consent Calendar, as presented.
  Commissioner Iglesias seconded the motion, which carried 5-0.
7.  New and Old Business
7A.  Review and consideration of canceling the July 2026 Parks and Recreation Commission
  meeting and changing the time of the August 2026 Parks and Recreation Commission
  meeting

  There were no public comments on this item.

  MOTION: Chair Prado moved to cancel the July 2026 Parks and Recreation
  Commissionmeeting and change the time of the August 2026 Parksand Recreation
  Commission meeting to 5:00 p.m. Commissioner Patnaik seconded the motion, which
  carried 5-0.

7B.  Reviewand consideration of an evaluation of the 2025 Youth Soccer League and
  Awards Program

  Recreation Services Administrator Jill Toda displayed a PowerPoint presentation with
  details of the report.

  Discussionfollowed regarding the number of games per week, evaluation results,
  residentand non-resident registration, and trophies and medals.

  There were no public comments on this item.

  MOTION: Commissioner DeLeon moved to receive and file the report. Vice Chair
  Patnaik secondedthe motion, which carried 5-0.
8.  Reports
8A.  Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison

  Ms. Toda provided an update on Recreation Services programs, classes, and activities.

  Community Services Supervisor Jesse Zavala provided details of Senior Center
  programs, classes and activities, including recent and upcoming excursions and the
  upcoming Health and Wellness Fair.

  The Commission concurred to receive and file the report.

8B.  Reports from Parks and Recreation Commission Members

  Chair Prado, Vice Chair Patnaik and Commissioner Iglesias provided brief reports on
  events they attended .

9.  Adjournment
  The meeting was adjourned at 7:39 p.m.
